questions.subject: Microbiology
questions.question_text: Antigenic shift in influenza is due to?

options.B: Reassortment of RNA segments between human and animal strains

questions.explanation: Antigenic shift: exchange of RNA segments (reassortment) between human and avian/porcine strains → new HA/NA subtype → pandemic potential. Antigenic drift: point mutations → seasonal epidemics.

questions.explanation: SSPE: defective measles virus persists in CNS after years → progressive dementia, myoclonus, EEG burst suppression. High CSF measles antibody titer is diagnostic.

questions.subject: Microbiology
questions.question_text: CMV inclusion in salivary gland disease?
questions.explanation: CMV: 'owl-eye' large intranuclear inclusions with surrounding halo. Also cytoplasmic inclusions. Causes congenital infection (periventricular calcifications), retinitis in HIV.

questions.subject: Microbiology
questions.question_text: Parvovirus B19 causes which condition in sickle cell anemia?
questions.explanation: Parvovirus B19: infects erythroid progenitors → aplastic crisis in patients with high RBC turnover (sickle cell, hereditary spherocytosis). Also causes fifth disease (slapped cheek) and hydrops fetalis.
